cues: Now the dark reaction, the Calvin cycle.
Dark does not mean it runs at night: it means it does not need light directly.
It runs in the stroma on the ATP and NADPH the light reaction made.
Calvin, Benson and Bassham traced it with radioactive carbon fourteen.
